The findings reveal how past climatic shifts shaped hornbill populations and provide valuable genetic resources to guide conservation strategies for these ecologically important seed dispersers

title: Delayed aid, prolonged ordeal
content: For tuberculosis (TB) patients from economically backward regions, financial assistance through government initiatives is as crucial as medication. title: 2003 Muthanga land struggle: two decades later, all accused who faced trial in constable murder case acquitted;  Geethanandan, three others convicted in related offences
content: ​Writing the long-awaited verdict, Judge E. Ayyoobkhan set all of them free, as the prosecution had failed to prove beyond reasonable doubt that there had been a prior conspiracy to murder the police officer. Though the court found Ashokan, the second accused, guilty of delivering the fatal blow to Vinod’s head, the murder charge against him had to be abated as he died during the trial

title: 'Pak-trained Mujahideen turned guns inwards': MEA slams Islamabad over PoK crackdown
content: India condemned Pakistan's admission of training and arming militants who have turned against the state. The Ministry of External Affairs also criticized Pakistan's harsh crackdown on protesters in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir. Over forty civilians were reportedly killed during the violent suppression of peaceful demonstrations. India stated that Pakistan's actions exposed its disdain for the region's innocent inhabitants.

title: CWG: India strike double gold in judo as Asmita Dey, Harsh Singh make history
content: Asmita created history by becoming the first Indian judoka to win a Commonwealth Games gold medal after defeating Canada's Heidi Quach in the women's 48kg final.

title: When a district in Florida's Everglades used robot rabbits to eliminate Burmese pythons
content: Florida is employing AI-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons. These solar-powered decoys mimic prey using heat and scent to lure snakes. When a python is detected, officials are alerted to remove the invasive species. This technology complements the annual Python Challenge, which has removed thousands of snakes. These efforts aim to control the python population impacting native wildlife.

title: Hockey jersey row: Dilip Tirkey questions process, his federation cites precedent
content: Hockey India president Dilip Tirkey questioned the jersey colour change process.  He stated the decision lacked executive board discussion and his prior knowledge.  Executive director RK Srivastava defended the saffron kit based on technical and performance factors.  Other board members also raised concerns about transparency and accountability.  This controversy emerges amid ongoing governance scrutiny for Hockey India.

title: 'I felt that everything was over': Asmita remembers late father after historic judo gold
content: Asmita Dey secured India's first judo gold medal at the Commonwealth Games. She defeated Canada's Heidi Quach in a gripping golden score final match. This historic victory came after overcoming personal tragedy and immense dedication. Harsh Singh also won a gold medal in the men's 60kg judo event. These twin triumphs marked a significant breakthrough for Indian judo.

title: Meta AI head has message for Google Cloud executive joining Scale AI
content: Francis deSouza has been appointed the new CEO of Scale AI. He previously served as chief operating officer at Google Cloud. DeSouza aims to position Scale AI as an enterprise AI company. He replaces interim chief executive Jason Droege, who led the company after founder Alexandr Wang's departure. Wang congratulated deSouza on his new leadership role at Scale AI.

title: MAGA piles on to Morocco as Trump twits Spain over Ceuta
content: The migrant surge into Ceuta is escalating into a geopolitical flashpoint. President Trump is using the crisis to reinforce his border security message. This event is also fueling online conspiracy theories linking it to wider international disputes. US officials have intervened in Spain's domestic politics regarding immigration policies. The situation highlights strained US-Spain relations and territorial claims over Ceuta.

title: Singapore student vanishes after Cambodia flight ticket is found
content: A Singaporean student, Siti Aishah Siregar, disappeared after telling her family she was going to college. Her family discovered her passport missing and a flight ticket to Cambodia in her email. Singapore police confirmed the 20-year-old had already departed the country on an outbound flight. Her father issued an emotional appeal on Facebook for assistance to locate his daughter.

title: $215K Colorado home sold as-is with woman refusing to leave
content: A unique property in Colorado is on the market but comes with a twist: prospective buyers cannot conduct inspections. The current resident, entrenched due to a drawn-out foreclosure process and personal loss, is determined to defend her home against eviction efforts. Real estate experts caution potential buyers about the substantial legal and financial pitfalls they may encounter in this unusual situation.

title: US plans $100K fee on foreign students: What it means for engineers
content: The US government is reportedly considering a $100,000 fee for foreign students seeking post-graduation work. This proposed fee targets the Optional Practical Training program, impacting many international graduates.  This follows a significant H-1B visa fee hike imposed on sponsoring companies last year.  Indian engineers, who dominate H-1B approvals, face increased challenges in securing US careers.  The new measures may significantly narrow career paths for many skilled foreign professionals.

title: Heaps of cash & gold, 242 vehicles & more: WB CM Suvendu lists Tulu Mondal's assets
content: Authorities have confiscated more than Rs 150 crore in cash, gold, and various assets belonging to mining mogul Tulu Mondal. This haul comprises numerous vehicles, petrol pumps, and several properties. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari attributed the rise of this illegal operation to the former Chief Minister, claiming that illegal stone mining led to a staggering Rs 15,000 crore revenue loss over a stretch of fifteen years.

title: How Travis Kelce turned criticism into one of the NFL's greatest careers ever
content: For Travis Kelce, constructive criticism serves as a catalyst for growth and improvement.  His passion for football, established long before his fame, has fueled his journey. Despite setbacks, such as not making the 2025 NFL playoffs, Kelce stresses the importance of embracing feedback and maintaining daily dedication to progress, especially for younger generations.

title: How childhood heartbreak forged Dak Prescott into Cowboys' resilient leader now!
content: Dak Prescott lost his mother to colon cancer in 2013 and his brother Jace to suicide in April 2020, and kept playing. The Dallas Cowboys quarterback has never hidden from grief. He's used it. Here's the story of the setbacks that quietly built one of the NFL's toughest competitors.

title: How to get Fortnite Spider-Man Brand New Day skins: Bundle, price and more
content: Fortnite's latest update introduces Spider-Man and Punisher skins from the Brand New Day collaboration. Players can acquire these popular character outfits and related cosmetic items through the in-game Item Shop. The bundle offers significant value, featuring seven cosmetic items for 2,400 V-Bucks. Individual items are also available for separate purchase, catering to different player preferences. These highly anticipated skins will be available for a limited time until August 9, 2026.

title: Brittany Mahomes turns $325M success into a powerful message for mothers today
content: Kansas City Chiefs star Patrick Mahomes' wife, Brittany Mahomes, shared a heartfelt message about motherhood, leadership and the next generation while celebrating another major milestone beyond football. The Kansas City Current co-owner reflected on why she wants her children to see women in leadership as the norm after helping build one of the biggest success stories in women's sports. Here's what Brittany said during her speech, why she was honored, Patrick Mahomes' loving reaction, and how her impact continues to shape opportunities for women on and off the field

title: Tough road for Trump: Why sanctions Bill for tariffs on Russian oil buyers may fail
content: Lawmakers from both parties, along with industry trade groups, have raised concerns over a section of the legislation that would allow Trump to impose hefty tariffs on countries that buy significant volumes of Russian oil and gas.

title: Rashmika Mandanna suffers major hip injury on set; doctors advise six weeks of rest
content: Actress Rashmika Mandanna sustained a major hip injury while filming an intense dance sequence. Doctors have advised her a complete rest period of six weeks for recovery. This injury will likely impact her ongoing film schedules and endorsement commitments. Mandanna is currently working on several big-budget films and numerous brand endorsements. Fans are sending well wishes for her swift return to full fitness.

title: Mukesh Khanna says CJP doesn't represent students or Gen Z
content: Veteran actor Mukesh Khanna has weighed in on the ongoing controversy surrounding the recent Gen Z protests, reacting to the self-styled Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) and backing criticism over the alleged use of abusive language against Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The actor described some protesters as "cockroaches" and alleged that they did not represent genuine students. His comments come days after actress-politician Kangana Ranaut sparked a row by referring to some protesters as "gutter chhaap" and condemning the language used during the demonstrations and on social media.

title: Perfect 5-0! Indian boxers storm into CWG finals after dominant semifinal sweep
content: India's boxing contingent achieved a flawless 5-0 record in the semifinals. Five Indian boxers have now secured spots in the gold medal bouts. Arundhati Choudhary defeated the defending champion in a significant upset victory. Jaismine Lamboria and Preeti Pawar also advanced with dominant performances. Ankush Panghal and Jadumani Singh completed the perfect sweep for India.

title: ‘Samudra Manthan’: Cabinet approves Rs 84,084 cr scheme for oil & gas exploration
content: The scheme will be implemented through FY2030-31 with an aim to harness India's vast offshore energy resources - in what the government has termed as a modern day Samudra Manthan.

title: 'Clarify algorithmic bias': Govt summons Meta's global team over PM Modi post
content: India's government has summoned Meta's global team to discuss Prime Minister Modi's post. Officials will question the social media giant on algorithmic bias and content moderation. Meta's global representatives will also appear before a parliamentary panel for scrutiny. Hyderabad police have also registered cases against Meta India's head. This marks an escalation in the government's oversight of the company's practices.

title: Russia hits Ukraine military cargo vessel near Odesa as Kyiv targets oil refinery
content: Russia claimed striking a vessel near Odesa carrying military cargo. Ukraine reported hitting Russia's Volgograd oil refinery and port infrastructure. Both nations are increasingly targeting logistics and supply chains. This escalation highlights the Black Sea's crucial role in the ongoing conflict. Ukraine also continues its campaign against Russian logistics targets.

title: India likely to play waiting game with Bumrah for Sri Lanka Tests | Exclusive

title: Vedika Pinto's sea-facing Mumbai home with Goan-Portuguese charm

From a restored newspaper artwork bought in Beirut to a painting with a cheeky "Green Choli" backstory, Vedika opens up about the stories behind her home's most striking corners.

title: 'Done by BJP goons': CJP's Dipke responds after injured Delhi cops' kin seek justice

CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke suggested a deliberate effort to target students amid the protests, expressing concern for the hurt officers while also questioning how students were being treated. The families presented proof of injuries and extensive damage, asserting that anti-social groups had incited the violence.

The standoff centres on FIFA’s plan to sell a minority stake in commercial rights, which has triggered widespread opposition, internal criticism and fears the centenary World Cup could be reshaped by a historic football power struggle.

title: Rajinikanth skipped Malaysia launch for 'Jailer 2' to avoid Vijay comparisons
